acceptance: A design that passes architecture review. Five review rounds of two designs (root inference; explicit root + guard) failed on: pre-resolving facades, continuation-registry writers, Roots.ProjectRoot beside Roots.EvolveDir, two Claimer callers, a syntax-only guard, a CI allow list that cannot be pinned. Review texts: scratchpad hi/lat/L-arch*.txt, L2-arch*.txt (2026-11-14).
The new tests are red without the change
evidence: inboxmover.Options derives its ledger, ActiveCycleFn and the git probes from ProjectRoot; 8 production literals pass only InboxDir (deliverable/effects.go:73, triagecap/lane_menu.go:86, phases/triage/triage.go:189, cmd_inbox.go:132, cmd_loop_goal_ids.go:69, cmd_cycle.go:699,820, cmd_supply_wiring.go:63), so from a non-root working directory the lifecycle row and the landing probe use the wrong root. CI runs make test-integration, which has no treewalk guard, so test leaks went unseen (make test red on main 2026-11-14). The test-only leak fix shipped separately (L-min).
